title: Represent current-Principal Project preference-shaped reads without confusing absence with unsynchronized data

requirements.invariant: This provider-free primitive can represent ordered category-identity evidence if O-040 retains personal pins, but it neither approves that feature nor supplies spend, allocation or contribution authority. O-040 separately owns pin survival/types and every no-pin/default/detail/card presentation outcome.

The verified primitive binds one candidate row shape to AccountID, PrincipalID and ProjectID with ordered unique BudgetCategoryIDs and revision, but this is representational evidence rather than approval of a target row, pin feature, Overall target, missing/empty/default/fallback or lifecycle policy.

requirements.section: Security and Sync Requirements for Later Target Mapping
requirements.invariant: The local directory contains only already-authorized preference rows for the authenticated Principal in the exact Account. Request AccountID and PrincipalID are expected scope, not authority; later trusted session, RLS and Sync boundaries must derive and enforce the Principal and never expose another Principal's rows or hidden count.

The primitive can preserve identity/order evidence without deleting unresolved IDs, but O-040 decides whether and how those source facts map to target preference, typed Overall, lifecycle and cleanup behavior. This read contract imports no source row and approves no migration disposition.

The current-Principal preference directory is an immutable local read model with exact query fingerprint, LocalDataVersion, visible-row count, readiness/quality, completeness and as-of evidence. A missing Project row means not stored only when directory evidence is complete; otherwise lookup reports not available.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral ProjectPreferenceQuerying port exposes the exact scoped local directory using domain and standard Swift types only; it contains no generic CRUD, listener registration, preference writer, authentication implementation or backend SDK type.

This Phase 1 read boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no preference row/table, RLS policy, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ProjectPreferenceSnapshot is a verified provider-free representational primitive binding stable AccountID, PrincipalID and ProjectID to ordered duplicate-free BudgetCategoryIDs and revision. Its empty-row capability is not product approval that pins survive or that missing/empty/no-pin/default/card outcomes have any particular meaning under O-040.

ProjectPreferenceDirectoryRequest binds exact Account/Principal expected scope to one derived query fingerprint. Serialized requests reconstruct the fingerprint rather than trusting caller-supplied derived evidence.

ProjectPreferenceDirectorySnapshot validates request fingerprint, finite as-of time, exact row scope, unique Project rows and already-authorized visible count, then canonicalizes rows by ProjectID without changing pin order.

ProjectPreferenceLookupState distinguishes stored preference, authoritative notStored from a complete directory, and notAvailable from incomplete local evidence. It does not synthesize first-use defaults or resolve category visibility.

ProjectPreferenceQuerying exposes only watchProjectPreferences(request:) local streams; ProjectPreferenceDataFailure supplies stable bounded scope/identity/pin/fingerprint/readiness/request/encoding codes.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no project_preferences table, Principal/Project foreign key, pin relation/array, revision column, uniqueness rule, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative preference query/write handler, authenticated Principal derivation, Project/category preflight, idempotency result or conflict resolution is implemented.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/Principal/Project scope and already-authorized local values are not authorization. No own-Principal predicate, membership check, grant or RLS policy exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, bucket parameter, local preference table, authenticated download predicate or synchronized completeness proof is defined.

items: Request, row and directory values are canonical Codable evidence and reconstruct through the same scope, pin uniqueness, fingerprint, count, completeness and timestamp validators.
Ready, partial, stale and authoritative-empty local directories retain exact LocalDataVersion/as-of evidence; missing-row lookup is notStored only for complete evidence and is notAvailable otherwise.
Cross-Account/Principal rows, duplicate Projects or pins, mismatched query fingerprints/counts/requests and malformed encoded values fail atomically without returning a partial preference directory.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project preferences contain no image URL, AttachmentPath, byte reference, cache, upload, retention or deletion behavior.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Project list/detail presentation, default-pin derivation, MCP schema/tool, transport handler, capability registration or app/MCP parity wiring is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase user-path preference, nullable field variant, duplicate pin, stale Project/category reference or source Principal correlation is decoded, normalized, quarantined or reconciled.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no telemetry signal, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot authorize a Principal, persist/display a preference, resolve category visibility, calculate budgets, write pins, define schema/RLS/Sync/provider/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-040, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-016, physical offline verification, canonical production preference profiling and all hosted-resource authority remain outside this read boundary.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic rows preserve exact Account/Principal/Project identity, ordered unique pins, empty stored state and revision while excluding category labels/lifecycle, budget values, user paths, authorization and provider data.

Ready, partial, stale and authoritative-empty current-Principal directories round-trip byte-identically with exact query fingerprint, row/pin order, revisions, LocalDataVersion, completeness, quality and as-of evidence; lookup preserves stored/notStored/notAvailable truth.

Cross-Account/Principal rows, duplicate Project identities or pinned category IDs, fingerprint/count/request mismatch, invalid as-of time and malformed decoded values fail atomically through stable codes.
A deterministic reference port returns only the exact Account/Principal directory, rejects request/snapshot mismatch without yielding rows, and a failing port yields no false snapshot.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming authentication, persistence, schema, Sync, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Verified provider-free Phase 1 representational primitive at exact implementation commit 59526ccc33c5317768dc0e986f6c91bf24b2a441 and immutable Actions run 33624655214. It proves typed current-Principal-shaped scope, ordered stable category-ID evidence, revision and absence-versus-incomplete-local mechanics only. It is not canonical product approval that pinning survives and does not decide typed Overall, missing/empty/no-pin/default/detail/card fallback, lifecycle or cleanup under O-040. It does not calculate budgets, authorize a caller, define schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider behavior, wire app/MCP, migrate source data, provision hosted resources or authorize production/cutover.
